# Descriptions
@@ 1
Creates an area of up to 20' radius about the point touched. The darkness is
equal to the darkest night. If the point is on a mobile target, it will move
with the target. See Section 15.12 (p. 98).
@@ 2
Target can see 100' in normal darkness as if it were day.
@@ 3
Caster can vary the intensity of darkness in the area, but he cannot lighten
it past its natural state.
@@ 5
As Darkness II, except radius is 100'.
@@ 6
As Nightvision, except caster can see in all darkness (even magical).
@@ 7
As Dark Control II, except range and radius are 50'.
@@ 8
Caster can create either the visual illusion of shadowy figures, or real
shadows (as many as the caster’s level); they will move when he concentrates.
See Section 15.14 (p. 98) for more on illusions.
@@ 9
As Darkness II, except radius is 300'.
@@ 10
Creates a 20' radius area of darkness. No nonmagic light can exist and magic
light (except Utterlight) must make a RR or be cancelled.
@@ 11
As Dark Control II, except range and radius are100'.
@@ 12
As Dark Vision, except the target can see as far as he would be allowed in
daylight.
@@ 13
As Lesser Utterdark, except radius is 100'.
@@ 14
As Darkness II, except radius is 500'.
@@ 15
Creates a “cloud” of darkness that has a 100' radius and drifts with the wind.
The darkness can vary in intensity from an overcast day to the dark of night.
@@ 16
As Nightvision, except affects a number of targets equal to caster’s level.
@@ 17
As Lesser Utterdark, except area of effect is 200'.
@@ 18
As Darkvision, except affects a number of targets equal to caster’s level.
@@ 19
As Clouds of Darkness I, except for area of effect.
@@ 20
As Darkness II, except radius is 1,000'.
@@ 25
As Lesser Utterdark, except radius is 300'.
@@ 30
As Darkness II, except radius is 100' per level of the caster.
@@ 50
As Clouds of Darkness I, except radius is 1 mile per level of the caster.
